affordance_manifest.success: `1 <= n <= items.length` → removes `items[n-1]`, shifts subsequent items left, saves, prints `Removed: "N) <text>"` to stdout, exit 0 — no other item's `text`/`done` value changes
affordance_manifest.error: missing `<n>` → `E_MISSING_INDEX` to stderr, exit 1, store untouched; non-integer `<n>` → `E_INVALID_INDEX` to stderr, exit 1, store untouched (never bare `Number()`/`parseInt()`); out-of-range integer (`< 1` or `> items.length`) → `E_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE` to stderr, exit 1, store untouched; corrupted store → corrupted-store message to stderr, exit 1, store untouched
affordance_manifest.empty: `rm 1` against a 0-item store → `E_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE`, no file created/modified

tasks.title: Implement `todo rm <n>` command
acceptance_criteria: `node bin/todo.js rm 1` on a store with ≥1 item removes item 1, saves, prints
`node bin/todo.js rm` (no index) exits 1 with `E_MISSING_INDEX` to stderr, store unchanged
`node bin/todo.js rm abc` exits 1 with `E_INVALID_INDEX` to stderr, store unchanged
Removing an item shifts later items left by one position (verified via a subsequent `list`
Removing an item does not alter the `text`/`done` value of any remaining item
At min value (`1`, with ≥1 item): accepted, removes the first item
At max value (`items.length`, exact upper bound): accepted, removes the last item
